name: Thilastikosuchus
sum: Thilastikosuchus is a candidodontid notosuchian from the Early Cretaceous Quiricó Formation of Brazil, the oldest known notosuchian of the country.
wsnote: The holotype is a juvenile and no adult size is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: FUP-Pv-000019, a well-preserved articulated skeleton of a juvenile individual (Quiricó Formation, Sanfranciscana Basin, Brazil).
material: The holotype only, with parts of the skull missing (premaxillae, lacrimals, prefrontals, palpebrals, palatines).
biology: The sources consulted describe its anatomy (rectangular back of the skull, pointed snout) but give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Carvalho et al. 2025

images.caption: Skull of the holotype of Thilastikosuchus scutorectangularis.
